title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About CleverTap:

CleverTap is the world’s No. 1 retention cloud that empowers digital consumer brands to increase customer retention and lifetime value. CleverTap drives contextual individualization with the help of a unified and deep data layer, AI/ML-powered insights, and automation, enabling brands to offer hyper-personalized and delightful experiences to their customers.


More than 1,300 customers in 100 countries and across 10,000 apps — including Gojek, ShopX, Canon, Electronic Arts, TED, English Premier League, TD Bank, Carousell, AirAsia, Papa John’s, Tesco, Kotak Mahindra Bank, SonyLiv, Swiggy, PharmEasy, and Dream11 — trust CleverTap to achieve their retention and engagement goals and grow their long-term revenue.


Backed by leading investors such as Sequoia India, Tiger Global, Accel, CDPQ, and Recruit Holdings, the company is headquartered in Mountain View, California, with offices in Mumbai, Singapore, Sofia, São Paulo, Bogota, Amsterdam, Jakarta, and Dubai. For more information, visit clevertap.com or follow on LinkedIn and Twitter.


About the Function:

We are outcome driven and we run with heart while leading with our core values:

P : Act with First Principles

I : Take Initiative

L : Seek to Learn

O : Take Ownership of Outcomes

T : Help Achieve Together

S : Speak up then Commit


About the Role:

We’re in hyper-growth mode, and this role is instrumental in keeping us on our upward trajectory. This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about sales and looking to use this opportunity as a launchpad into outside sales. Learn firsthand how your efforts lead to opportunities for the company and become skilled in researching potential customers, creative outreach, enticing potential clients.


What will you do:

  • Begin the Relationship: As the first point of contact for future clients, you will enthusiastically explain CleverTap’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest. Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities.
  • Customer and Industry Knowledge: Customers are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded customer and industry knowledge. Researching customers’ business and staying informed on industry trends will be keys to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to plan for success, pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high-level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.


What are we looking for?

Must have:

  • At least 3 years of B2B sales experience, preferable in a SaaS-based product company
  • Fluent in English
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed sales team
  • Strong and professional communication skills -- written, verbal, presentation
  • Aptitude to manage numerous requests and time demands concurrently, while achieving production goals from assigned territory or set of accounts
  • Promotes a strong sense of urgency for reaching goals and key deliverables. Acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company


Good to have:

  • Fluency in Spanish
  • Experience using Salesforce Sales Cloud is a plus
  • Knowledge of MarTech solutions


Measures of Success:

  • Qualified leads
  • Funnel size
  • Conversion rates


Competencies:

  • Functional: Mobile marketing expertise, Martech understanding, Result oriented are desirable
  • Behavioral: Problem Solving, Consultative selling, Communication and presentation skills, Negotiation Skills


Who will you report to: LATAM BDR Team Lead


Why join us?

- Be a part of a global growth stage startup

- Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contribution matters

- You are passionate about technology and its impact on the high growth mobile technology space

- Innovate at scale, with learning opportunities


What is working at CleverTap like?

- Be a part of a global category creator - hyper growth B2B SaaS startup

- Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contribution matters

- Work, performance and results are real sources of happiness in addition to the fun of working with and celebrating success with an exceptionally talented team

- Accountability and driving outcomes is the key to success

- Your career here is limited by you and nothing else

- Teamwork trumps individual success

- You are passionate about experience technology and its impact on enabling growth

  • - Innovate at scale, with learning opportunities and having fun along the way!

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst with solid experience in statistics and data quality. This professional will be responsible for validating, certifying, and critically analyzing data—from raw sources to analytical models—to support strategic decision-making.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure data integrity through validation scripts and quality checks

• Certify data across all stages: raw, variables, and models

• Deliver insights, KPIs, and studies to support business strategies

• Collaborate with analytics and business teams to define validation needs

• Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Identify risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities for data improvement

________________________________________

Requirements

• Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or related fields

• Proven experience in data validation and quality assurance

• Strong background in statistics and model validation

• Advanced SQL and experience with tools like BigQuery

• Desirable: Python, Git, Airflow, DBT

• Experience validating analytical models

• Advanced English

• Critical thinking, attention to detail, and strong communication skills

________________________________________

Nice to Have

• Experience with credit, risk, or behavioral modeling

• Familiarity with metrics like KS, PSI, variable stability, and bias

• Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, Azure)

title: PHP Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for PHP Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Able to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as collaborate with a diverse team.

- Accountable for resolution of the most technically challenging issues facing the organization.

- Write code with increasing quality and maintainability.

- Guide the architecture of large features which impact all parts of the company, identifying issues and raising concerns/blockers for mitigation.

- Research and introduce new technology to improve the applications and/or the development pipeline.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience working with PHP with strong Front-End skills.

- Workflow Management, design and implementation in all its stages.

- Collaboration with the development team in the achievement of technical challenges, code upgrades, working closely with architects, developers, business analysts, testers and product owners.

- Contribution to the preparation of technical documentation.

- Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and other frameworks such as, among others, Angular and React.

- Experience with frameworks such as Zend, Laravel, Symphony is desirable.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.


MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.


Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.



Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
description:
About the job


We are looking for a talented Kitchen Sales Designer to join our growing team in Latin America. In this role, you’ll help homeowners create kitchens that are both beautiful and practical. You bring a passion for design, sales, and innovation — always keeping the customer at the center. Together with experienced colleagues, you’ll thrive in a dynamic, creative environment.


What is CORNER Renovation?


CORNER is a kitchen brand dedicated to designing and manufacturing high-quality custom kitchens for homeowners worldwide. As a technology-driven company, we develop our own tools to make renovation seamless. With a distributed team in Ukraine and Argentina, and a growing presence across Latin America, we’re expanding quickly and looking for new talent to join us.


Our mission is simple: to help people create the living spaces they dream of. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.


Requirements:

  • Strong sense of our style, with the ability to translate it into innovative, next-level designs that combine functionality and aesthetics.
  • Must have fluent/Advanced English
  • Flexibility to work with clients across different time zones
  • Experience with SketchUp and V-ray 
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, able to drive projects forward independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Good understanding of cabinet construction, hardware and assembly, ensuring designs are practical and production-ready.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to build trust and guide clients through decision-making
  • 5+ years of work experience in the furniture and kitchen design industry
  • Knowledge of 3ds Max/Corona is a plus


Responsibilities:

  • Own the entire project cycle, from company presentation to final design.
  • Keep yourself fully updated on our product range, features, and capabilities, while exploring innovative ways to apply them in design solutions.
  • Develop kitchen and other space designs based on details collected from clients.
  • Conduct online meetings with new and existing clients to understand their requirements.
  • Prepare layouts and design presentations for clients.
  • Provide guidance on efficient kitchen layouts, including the selection of storage solutions.
  • Review technical drawings and orders before production.
  • Assist in selecting appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting.
  • Communicate with the internal team to ensure alignment across project details, timelines, and client expectations.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project, ensuring clear communication, smooth process, and an excellent client experience.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Professional growth and experience working with international clients
  • Flexible vacation and holiday schedule
  • Company covers 50% of course costs


Looking to work for a fast-growing startup with great career opportunities? We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are ready to work hard, and eager to learn and develop their skills.

After you apply, we will review your application. If it meets our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the details and schedule an interview.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
We are hiring a Senior HR Recruiter (Remote | Full-Time)

Help shape the future of our team by attracting and hiring top talent for a fast-growing international company.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Senior HR Recruiter who thrives in dynamic environments and has a proven track record of building strong teams. In this role, you will manage end-to-end recruitment processes, collaborate closely with leadership, and implement strategies to attract high-performing professionals across different functions.


About the Role

You will be responsible for leading recruitment efforts for diverse roles, from marketing to operations, ensuring an excellent candidate experience and alignment with business needs. This position requires strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to identify and engage top talent globally.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing and screening to offers and onboarding
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and design tailored recruitment strategies
  • Develop and maintain a strong talent pipeline through proactive sourcing and networking
  • Conduct competency-based interviews and assessments to identify best-fit candidates
  • Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring process
  • Track recruitment metrics and provide regular reports and insights to leadership
  • Stay updated on recruitment trends and best practices in global talent acquisition


Requirements

  • Proven experience as an HR Recruiter, with at least 3–5 years in senior or lead recruitment roles
  • Strong understanding of sourcing techniques, recruitment tools, and employer branding strategies
  • Experience recruiting across different functions (marketing, operations, creative, etc.)
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Fluency in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week with flexibility


Why Join Us

  • Fully remote role with flexible scheduling
  • Opportunity to shape the growth of an international company
  • Career development and advancement opportunities
  • Collaborative and people-focused work environment

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:


1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth


Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a People Operations Specialist to join our growing global HR team. This role will be an Individual Contributor (IC) position, focused on managing core People Ops activities and supporting employees across multiple regions. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter, detail-oriented, and collaborative professional with experience in global organizations and the ability to work across time zones.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end People Operations processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and other employment changes.
  • Provide support to employees and stakeholders globally, ensuring consistent and seamless People Operations across regions.
  • Maintain and update HR systems (primarily HiBob, with exposure to Microsoft Office and HRIS tools) to ensure accurate employee records and reporting.
  • Partner with hiring managers and global HR peers to deliver guidance, promote best practices, and ensure compliance with internal policies.
  • Handle confidential employee data with the highest level of discretion, accuracy, and compliance with data privacy requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve HR processes, streamline workflows, and enhance communication throughout the employee lifecycle.
  • Contribute to employee engagement initiatives, helping foster cultural alignment and connection within a distributed workforce.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in HR/People Operations, ideally in a tech or fast-paced global organization.
  • Strong working knowledge of HR processes and compliance frameworks globally.
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., HiBob, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across cultures and time zones.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.


Soft Skills

  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Problem-solving mindset with flexibility to adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • High level of integrity and confidentiality.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a fully remote role.
  • Exposure to global HR operations and cross-cultural teams.
  • Clear career growth opportunities within a scaling People Ops team.
  • Be part of a collaborative and supportive environment focused on innovation and impact.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.


EEO

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades

  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de CI/CD robustas e escaláveis, com foco em GitLab e ArgoCD .
  • Definir padrões e melhores práticas para Dockerfiles e gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Administrar e otimizar clusters OKE (Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes) em produção.
  • Liderar a automação de infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform .
  • Implementar estratégias completas de observabilidade , com Grafana, Dynatrace e Datadog .
  • Integrar ferramentas de segurança e qualidade de código, como Sonarqube e Veracode , ao ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir testes de performance com K6 e definir métricas de sucesso.
  • Liderar a implantação de soluções de autoscaling (Keda) e otimizações (Redwolf).
  • Mentorar a equipe, disseminando as melhores práticas de DevOps e SRE .


Requisitos

  • Experiência sênior como DevOps ou SRE .
  • Profundo conhecimento em CI/CD e automação de processos .
  • Expertise comprovada em GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD .
  • Experiência avançada em Kubernetes, OKE e Helm .
  • Domínio de Terraform para IaC.
  • Experiência na implementação e gestão de observabilidade (Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog).
  • Vivência com testes de performance (K6) .
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança de código (Sonarqube, Veracode).
  • Experiência prática com Keda e Redwolf .
  • Forte conhecimento em OCI e GCP .
  • Vivência em liderança técnica ou mentoring .


Atuação Remota em horário comercial.


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Agriculture Specialist
description:
We are looking for Image Annotation Analyst having background in Agriculture from Brazil. If you are interested and reside in Brazil, kindly apply to the post on urgent basis as we are anticipating the project to get started this week.


Please find the details below: -

  • Project Name: Image Annotation Analyst- Agriculture
  • Hourly Rate: $16 per hour
  • Required Hours: 5-6 hours per day (flexible hours)
  • Project Start Date: This week
  • Location: Brazil
  • Language: local
  • Required Education: Agriculture or agriculture related streams like horticulture , food science etc.


We are looking for an Annotation Analyst to join the team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for annotating agriculture dataset, identifying crop type and stages, ensuring the quality, consistency, and accuracy of datasets. Raters are required to interpretate crop types, annotation, and identifying the stages.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s/master’s degree in agriculture
  • Experience in agricultural field studies and data annotation.
  • Knowledge of crop classification, phenology (growth stages), and field boundary identification.
  • Prior work with street view imagery of agricultural datasets.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Ilustrador(a) / Artista Digital Freelancer até Dezembro – Início Imediato / Digital Artist Until December – Immediate Start
description:
Ilustrador Freelance – Início Imediato


Envie sua inscrição aqui:


A Scopio está contratando ilustradores e artistas digitais para entregar arquivos PSD editáveis e em camadas para um projeto global de tecnologia.

Este é um contrato remoto temporário que vai até dezembro. Os artistas devem atender a requisitos rigorosos para PSDs em camadas e deverão entregar de 10 a 20 arquivos até 7 de outubro de 2025 como parte do processo de integração.


Responsabilidades

  • Produzir ilustrações em PSD de alta qualidade, editáveis e em camadas (não são aceitos JPEGs nem exportações achatadas).
  • Entregar arquivos que atendam às especificações técnicas:
  • Tamanho mínimo: 2000×2000 px, 150 DPI, RGB.
  • Camadas organizadas com nomes claros em inglês (ex.: Character_1, Background_Sky).
  • Não serão aceitos PSDs achatados/rasterizados nem obras geradas por IA.
  • Trabalhar de forma independente e cumprir prazos curtos.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada na criação de ilustrações em PSD com camadas (portfólio obrigatório).
  • Capacidade de entregar 10–20 arquivos PSD até 7 de outubro de 2025 como lote de teste.
  • Forte habilidade em ilustração, incluindo personagens, cenários, objetos e cenas abstratas/editoriais.
  • Domínio em Photoshop, Illustrator (com exportação para PSD) ou Procreate (com exportação para PSD).
  • Compromisso com altos padrões de qualidade e organização de arquivos (guia fornecido).
  • Não serão aceitos: imagens geradas por IA, PSDs achatados, ícones, logotipos ou arquivos sem camadas editáveis.

Como Se Candidatar

  • Envie sua inscrição aqui: Illustrator Fund.
  • Leia as Perguntas Frequentes (FAQ) e o Guia de PSD antes de se candidatar.

  • FAQ: bit.ly/4g8T9A4

Freelance Illustrator – Immediate Start


Scopio is hiring illustrators and digital artists to deliver layered, editable PSD files for a global technology project.

This is a temporary remote contract that will run until December. Artists must meet strict requirements for layered PSDs and will be expected to deliver 10–20 files by October 7 as part of the onboarding process.

Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality layered, editable PSD illustrations (not JPEGs or flat exports).
  • Deliver files that meet technical specifications:
  • Minimum size: 2000×2000 px, 150 DPI, RGB color.
  • Organized layers with clear English names (e.g., Character_1, Background_Sky).
  • No flattened/rasterized PSDs and no AI-generated artwork.
  • Work independently and meet tight deadlines.


Requirements

  • Proven experience creating layered PSD illustrations (portfolio required).
  • Ability to deliver 10–20 PSD files by October 7, 2025, as a test batch.
  • Strong illustration skills, including characters, environments, objects, and abstract/editorial scenes.
  • Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator (with PSD export), or Procreate (with PSD export).
  • Commitment to strict quality and file organization standards (guide provided).
  • Not accepted: AI-generated images, flat PSDs, icons, logos, or files without editable layers.


1️⃣ Submit your application here:

2️⃣ Review before applying:

  • Campaign Brief: bit.ly/scopiocertifiedillustratorprogram
  • FAQ: bit.ly/4g8T9A4

⚠️ Applications without reviewing the PSD guide and FAQ may not be accepted.

Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.

- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.

title: Estagiário da Área Comercial
description:
Estágio Remunerado em Administração – Área Comercial 

Sobre a Waterloo

A Waterloo é uma consultoria ambiental que apoia empresas a encontrarem soluções sustentáveis e estarem em conformidade com a legislação. Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) para atuar na área comercial , aprendendo na prática como funciona a rotina de propostas, prospecções e organização de documentos.

O que você  fará  no dia a dia

  • Auxiliar o time comercial nas solicitações de propostas para fornecedores/parceiros;
  • Organizar pastas e arquivos digitais;
  • Apoiar o comercial na pesquisa de mercado e prospecção de novos clientes;

·       Apoiar o comercial em negociações junto aos fornecedores/parceiros;

·       Apoiar em tarefas administrativas gerais relacionadas à área comercial;

  • Atualizar e controlar documentações administrativa/jurídica;
  • Cadastrar e atualizar os sistemas CRM (Omie e Funil de Vendas);
  • Apoiar na atualização dos indicadores comerciais.

O que buscamos

  • Estar cursando Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade de comunicação;

·       Proatividade

·       Boa redação e comunicação escrita;

  • Conhecimento básico em Word, Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 6+ years of DevOps and AWS experience to work with other team members on maintaining and executing organizational policies and procedures for change management, configuration management, release and deployment management, service monitoring, support, and problem management of the client's solutions for internal and customer environments.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2,000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, which reduces operating costs, saves time, and increases profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their infrastructure requirements, design solutions with cost mitigation in mind that meet their needs, and implement transparently and efficiently
  • Manage and optimize AWS environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices via tools such as Terraform
  • Own the design, development, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines - ensure rapid yet reliable code deployments
  • Integrate security practices into the infrastructure development lifecycle, including network security, identity management, and data protection
  • Ensure the achievement of SLOs via the implementation of effective SLIs to monitor systems and aid in issue diagnosis
  • Expand documentation and provide training to ensure clarity and proficient management by others, reducing future onboarding time
  • Monitor and optimize cloud spending
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest cloud computing and DevOps trends and best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 6+ years of experience in architecting, deploying, and managing complex enterprise-grade software solutions using AWS across various delivery modalities - mobile applications, web applications, APIs, web services, and UI frameworks
  • Extensive experience with CI/CD pipeline optimization via IaC platforms, must be highly knowledgeable of Terraform
  • Solid experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), version control systems (Git), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, and more)
  • Proven site reliability experience achieving SLOs through the definition and implementation of effective SLIs
  • Experience with operational database management in AWS (Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL)
  • Deep understanding of modern security best practices and a proven track record of implementing secure solutions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A strong aptitude for tackling complex challenges with right-size solutions that mitigate costs while assuring exceptional end-user experiences
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in environments that are constantly evolving and occasionally ambiguous


Desired Experience (not required)

  • University degree in Business, MIS, or Engineering
  • Familiar with New Relic, Loggly, and CloudWatch
  • Skilled in shell scripting (e.g., Bash, Python, and PowerShell)


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment, while building software. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Project Manager
description:
If you are passionate about leading projects end-to-end, aligning teams, and ensuring clients achieve real results, this role is for you. At SMT, our Project Managers are strategic partners who shape outcomes and help clients unlock the full value of the Medallia platform.

What You Will Do

  • Lead implementation projects from discovery and design to testing, training, and go-live.
  • Act as the main point of contact with clients — building trust, managing expectations, and ensuring flawless delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (analysts, consultants, solution architects, developers, and client stakeholders) to meet milestones and deliverables on time.
  • Define project plans, schedules, and scope while proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Facilitate workshops and design sessions, ensuring clear communication and stakeholder engagement at every stage.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize delivery, enhance processes, and maximize client value.
  • Monitor progress and provide regular updates to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
  • Support and coach project team members, ensuring alignment with goals and high-quality results.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a Project Manager, preferably in SaaS or technology-driven environments.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong business acumen in project planning and management.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills to manage complex projects effectively.
  • Exceptional communication skills — equally comfortable with executives and technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with a focus on quality and client success.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish and French


✨ Join us and help transform how organizations understand and act on customer experience.

title: Node.js Engineer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Node.js Engineers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Vendedor, Subgerente e Gerente de Loja – Boulevard Shopping Belém
description:
Vendedor, Subgerente e Gerente de Loja – Boulevard Shopping Belém


O que buscamos!

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados por atender e encantar clientes! Se você tem empatia, escuta ativa, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de proporcionar experiências únicas, essa oportunidade é para você. Na Lindt, acreditamos que cada atendimento é uma chance de criar conexões verdadeiras e surpreender. Valorizamos quem contribui para um ambiente de loja vibrante, acolhedor e cheio de energia positiva onde o trabalho em equipe e o cuidado com cada detalhe fazem toda a diferença.

Venha construir momentos inesquecíveis conosco!


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial – Lindt Boulevard shopping Belém (Belém - PA)


VENDEDOR

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar o atendimento direto ao cliente, garantindo uma experiência de compra positiva por meio da apresentação, degustação e recomendação de produtos.
  • Atuar com foco no atingimento das metas comerciais, contribuindo de forma ativa para os resultados da loja.
  • Executar as atividades de venda, promovendo os produtos da companhia de forma consultiva, clara e eficiente.
  • Manter a organização, limpeza e conservação do ambiente de loja, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões globais de apresentação e atendimento.
  • Cumprir prazos e realizar tarefas operacionais com qualidade e atenção aos detalhes.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao cliente e vendas.
  • Perfil comunicativo, proativo e apaixonado por chocolates.


SUBGERENTE (VENDEDOR MASTER)

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a gestão e o desenvolvimento da equipe, contribuindo para o bom desempenho do time e assegurando a continuidade das ações gerenciais da loja, com foco no alcance das metas comerciais.
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento dos resultados, acompanhando indicadores, propondo estratégias e identificando oportunidades que contribuam para o atingimento dos objetivos definidos pela companhia.
  • Atuar nos controles operacionais da loja, garantindo a execução dos processos diários. relacionados a vendas, estoque, certificações e reportes, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho organizado e eficiente.
  • Apoiar, sempre que necessário, a administração geral da loja, colaborando com a condução das atividades da equipe, o desempenho comercial e o atendimento às demandas da matriz.
  • Participar das trocas de turno, garantindo o repasse claro e preciso de informações, destacando ocorrências relevantes, pendências e atividades concluídas, com o objetivo de manter a comunicação alinhada entre as equipes.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao cliente e vendas.
  • Vivência em liderança de equipe ou apoio à gestão será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil comunicativo, proativo e com forte senso de responsabilidade.
  • Paixão por encantar clientes e apaixonado por chocolates.


GERENTE DE LOJA

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar, recrutar e desenvolver a equipe da loja, de acordo com os padrões e diretrizes da companhia, garantindo a formação de times de alta performance alinhados aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os resultados de vendas, propondo estratégias comerciais e identificando oportunidades para maximizar o desempenho e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Gerenciar os processos operacionais da loja, assegurando a execução eficiente das rotinas diárias, incluindo vendas, controle de estoque, certificações e reportes, promovendo um ambiente organizado e colaborativo.
  • Atuar como multiplicador do programa global de atendimento, implementando e sustentando boas práticas de gestão e relacionamento com o cliente nas lojas próprias, reforçando os fundamentos aprendidos nos treinamentos.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo (ensino superior completo ou em andamento será considerado um diferencial).
  • Experiência sólida em vendas e atendimento ao cliente, com atuação comprovada em gestão de equipes no varejo.
  • Habilidade em liderar, desenvolver e motivar times, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Perfil analítico, com foco em resultados, organização e capacidade de tomada de decisão.
  • Excelente comunicação, proatividade e paixão por encantar clientes.
  • Afinidade com o segmento de chocolates ou produtos premium será um diferencial.



O que oferecemos para todas as posições!


Em nossa empresa, valorizamos cada colaborador como um pilar essencial do nosso sucesso. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios únicos que cuidam de você e de sua família!


  • Oferecemos benefícios de alimentação que valorizam sua autonomia. Com nosso VR e VA, você decide como e onde se alimentar, com qualidade e liberdade.
  • Convênio Médico: Nosso plano de saúde e odontológico garante o cuidado que você e sua família merecem.
  • Convênio com Academias: Bem-estar que faz parte do seu dia a dia! Temos parceria com academias para que você possa manter a energia e a saúde em alta. (Total Pass)
  • Remuneração variável Mensal: Valorizamos quem faz acontecer!
  • Aqui, você colhe os frutos do seu desempenho por meio de uma remuneração variável vinculada aos KPIs definidos e conforme a política vigente da empresa.
  • Seguro de Vida: Porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Nosso seguro de vida garante proteção e segurança em qualquer momento da jornada.
  • Desconto nos Produtos Lindt: Desfrute dos nossos chocolates inigualáveis com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.
  • Vale-Transporte: A gente cuida do seu caminho até aqui! Oferecemos VT conforme a legislação, para facilitar sua rotina.


Junte-se à Lindt

Venha encantar o mundo com chocolate!

Seja parte de uma equipe que transforma o cacau na mais pura arte.

Encante. Inove. Faça história na Lindt.

Inscreva-se e faça parte do legado!

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

description:
Required Qualifications:

This role focuses on developing intelligent, production-ready solutions that power personalization, forecasting, and automation across our digital platforms. The ideal candidate is a strong problem-solver, able to work independently, and comfortable supporting collaboration across time zones—including occasional calls outside standard working hours.
